units.text: Chapter 1. General provisions
units.label: Chapter 1. General provisions

units.text: Article 1. Local self-government
units.label: Art. 1

units.text: 1. Local self-government is a form of citizens’ self-organization recognized and guaranteed by the Constitution of the Russian Federation, for the purpose of the people exercising their power to independently resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life (matters of local significance), within the powers provided for, in accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, by this Federal Law, other federal laws and, in cases established by federal laws, laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 1

units.text: 2. Citizens exercise local self-government directly through forms of direct expression of their will, and also through local self-government bodies.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 1

units.text: 3. Local self-government is exercised throughout the territory of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 1

units.text: 4. In accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, local self-government bodies form part of the unified system of public authority in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 1

units.text: 5. The President of the Russian Federation ensures the coordinated functioning and interaction of bodies forming part of the unified system of public authority in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 1

units.text: 6. Local self-government bodies do not form part of the system of state authorities.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 1

units.text: 7. Public authorities participate in addressing the tasks of local self-government in accordance with this Federal Law and other federal laws.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 1

units.text: 8. Openness in the activities of local self-government bodies is guaranteed, including by providing access to information about the activities of local self-government bodies.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 2. Citizens’ rights to exercise local self-government
units.text: Article 2. Citizens’ rights to exercise local self-government
units.label: Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Citizens’ rights to exercise local self-government
units.text: 1. Citizens have equal rights to exercise local self-government irrespective of sex, race, ethnicity, language, origin, property status and official position, attitude to religion, convictions or membership in public associations.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Citizens’ rights to exercise local self-government
units.text: 2. Public authorities, in accordance with this Federal Law and other federal laws, ensure citizens’ rights to exercise local self-government established by the Constitution of the Russian Federation and this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 3. Legal basis of local self-government
units.text: Article 3. Legal basis of local self-government
units.label: Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Legal basis of local self-government
units.text: The legal basis of local self-government consists of the Constitution of the Russian Federation, universally recognized principles and rules of international law, international treaties of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, this Federal Law, other federal laws, other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation issued in accordance with them (decrees and executive orders of the President of the Russian Federation, resolutions of the Government of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts of federal executive authorities), constitutions (charters), laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, municipal charters, decisions adopted at local referendums and citizens’ assemblies, and other municipal legal acts.
units.label: Art. 3 · text

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government
units.text: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government
units.label: Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government
units.text: 1. Local self-government is independent within the limits of its powers.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government
units.text: 2. A local self-government body or a person holding a municipal office in one municipality may not be subordinate to a local self-government body or a person holding a municipal office in another municipality.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government
units.text: 3. The establishment, formation and activities of local self-government bodies, their powers and liability, and the procedure for interaction among them and with other bodies forming part of the unified system of public authority in the Russian Federation are based on the Constitution of the Russian Federation and are regulated by federal constitutional laws, this Federal Law, other federal laws, and also constitutions (charters), laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, municipal charters and other municipal legal acts.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government
units.text: 4. Municipal charters and other municipal legal acts may, in accordance with laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, provide for procedures for remote interaction between bodies forming part of the unified system of public authority in that constituent entity of the Russian Federation, and for remote participation in meetings of the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government
units.text: 5. Federal laws adopted in accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation and this Federal Law, other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation issued in accordance with them (decrees and executive orders of the President of the Russian Federation, resolutions and executive orders of the Government of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts of federal executive authorities), constitutions (charters), laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, municipal charters, decisions adopted at local referendums and citizens’ assemblies, and other municipal legal acts must, when regulating the organization of local self-government, take into account the socioeconomic, natural and climatic, territorial and other characteristics of the locality, as well as historical, cultural, ethnic and other local traditions, and ensure that tasks are addressed in the interests of the population residing in the relevant territory.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government
units.text: 6. If federal laws and/or other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation regulating the organization of local self-government conflict with the Constitution of the Russian Federation or this Federal Law, the Constitution of the Russian Federation and this Federal Law shall apply.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government
units.text: 7. If a constitution (charter), law or other regulatory legal act of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation regulating the organization of local self-government and establishing the rights, duties and liability of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials conflicts with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, this Federal Law or other federal laws, the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, this Federal Law and other federal laws shall apply.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government
units.text: 8. Expenditure obligations arising in connection with local self-government bodies exercising powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life are met from local budget funds (excluding subventions provided to local budgets from the federal budget and the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation). In the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and by regulatory legal acts of the representative body of the municipality adopted in accordance with them and local budgets, these expenditure obligations may additionally be financed from the federal budget, federal state extrabudgetary funds and the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government
units.text: 9. Municipalities may not be required to finance expenses arising from the exercise of powers by state authorities and/or local self-government bodies of other municipalities.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government
units.text: 10. The division of powers among levels of public authority shall be supported by corresponding financial means and material resources.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government
units.text: 11. A municipality is not an administrative-territorial unit. However, the boundaries of a municipality and an administrative-territorial unit may coincide.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Principles of the legal regulation of local self-government
units.text: 12. The general principles of the organization of local self-government established by this Federal Law may be changed only by amending this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 5. Powers of federal state authorities in the field of local self-government
units.text: Article 5. Powers of federal state authorities in the field of local self-government
units.label: Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Powers of federal state authorities in the field of local self-government
units.text: The powers of federal state authorities in the field of local self-government include:
units.label: Art. 5 · “The powers of federal state authorities in the field of local…”

units.locator: Article 5. Powers of federal state authorities in the field of local self-government
units.text: 1) determining the general principles of the organization of local self-government in the Russian Federation established by this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Powers of federal state authorities in the field of local self-government
units.text: 2) legal regulation, in matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation and within the powers of the Russian Federation in matters within the joint jurisdiction of the Russian Federation and its constituent entities, of the rights, duties and liability of federal state authorities and their officials, and of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their officials, in the field of local self-government;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Powers of federal state authorities in the field of local self-government
units.text: 3) legal regulation of the rights, duties and liability of citizens, local self-government bodies and local self-government officials in the field of local self-government;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Powers of federal state authorities in the field of local self-government
units.text: 4) legal regulation of the rights, duties and liability of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials when exercising individual state powers vested in local self-government bodies by federal laws in accordance with the procedure established by this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Powers of federal state authorities in the field of local self-government
units.text: 5) legal regulation of the specific features of the organization of local self-government in the territories of cities of federal significance, administrative centers (capitals) of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and other territories.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 6. Powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of local self-government
units.text: Article 6. Powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of local self-government
units.label: Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of local self-government
units.text: The powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of local self-government include:
units.label: Art. 6 · “The powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the…”

units.locator: Article 6. Powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of local self-government
units.text: 1) legal regulation of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of local self-government
units.text: 2) legal regulation of the rights, duties and liability of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their officials in the field of local self-government in the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by federal laws;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of local self-government
units.text: 3) legal regulation of the rights, duties and liability of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials in matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and also within the powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in matters within the joint jurisdiction of the Russian Federation and its constituent entities;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Powers of state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of local self-government
units.text: 4) legal regulation of the rights, duties and liability of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials when exercising individual state powers vested in local self-government bodies by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in accordance with the procedure established by this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 6

units.text: Article 7. Names of municipalities
units.label: Art. 7

units.text: 1. The name of a municipality is determined by its charter.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 7

units.text: 2. The name of a municipality must indicate its type and the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in which the municipality is located.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 7

units.text: 3. If the administrative center of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation is located in the territory of a municipality, the name of that municipality may omit the name of that constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 7

units.text: 4. Other elements of a municipality’s name may be determined by its charter, taking into account historical and other local traditions and the possession of honorary titles of the USSR and the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 7

units.text: 5. A municipal charter may provide for use of an abbreviated form of the municipality’s name in its official symbols, in the names of local self-government bodies and local self-government officials, and in other cases, on an equal basis with the name of that municipality determined by its charter in accordance with parts 2–4 of this Article.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 7

units.text: 6. The name of a municipality must be entered in the State Register of Municipalities of the Russian Federation, which is maintained by the authorized federal executive authority in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 7

units.text: Article 8. Official symbols of municipalities
units.label: Art. 8

units.text: 1. Municipalities may, in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation and heraldic rules, establish official symbols reflecting historical, cultural, ethnic and other local traditions and characteristics.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 8

units.text: 2. Official symbols of municipalities are subject to state registration in accordance with the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 8

units.text: 3. Official symbols of municipalities and the procedure for their official use are established by municipal charters and/or regulatory legal acts of municipal representative bodies.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 8
